newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DEUTSCHE TELEKOM TAKES STAKE IN SATELLITE SERVICE.
newsitem.headline: DEUTSCHE TELEKOM TAKES STAKE IN SATELLITE SERVICE.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG and U.S. company Hughes Network Systems (HNS) have each taken a participation in Luxembourg's recently set-up European Satellite Multimedia Services SA (ESM), Societe Europeenne des Satellites SA (SES) said in a statement.
No financial details nor the size of the stakes were given.
SES, Intel and the Luxembourg PTT telephone company were the initial shareholders in ESM. SES was its majority shareholder, the statement said.
"This decision allows us to exploit the existing synergies and further strengthen our position on the market," Deutsche Telekom board member Gerd Tenzer said in the statement.

The entry of these two new shareholders into ESM's capital completed the company's know-how in areas such as technical competence, operational experience and communication infrastructure, the statement added.
ESM offers the direct transmission of multimedia content to personal computers.
It plans to launch Astra Net - an open and independent communication platform which would use the Astra satellite system to broadcast a range of services to personal computers.
The satellite transmission would operate at a wide band width and would be much faster than conventional telephone lines, the statement said.
